rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a mechanical mechanism or apparatus.

example.english: This mechanism is used to control the conveyor belt's speed.
example.traditional: 呢部機械裝置係用嚟控制輸送帶速度嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gei1 haai6 zong1 zi3 hai6 jung6 lai4 hung3 zai3 syu1 sung3 daai2 cuk1 dou6 ge3

rows.note: Use this when the mechanism is being treated as a device or apparatus rather than focusing on its internal parts.

example.english: The safety mechanism automatically stops the machine when it detects someone approaching.
example.traditional: 個安全裝置一感應到有人行近就會自動停機。
example.jyutping: go3 on1 cyun4 zong1 zi3 jat1 gam2 jing3 dou3 jau5 jan4 haang4 gan6 zau6 wui6 zi6 dung6 ting4 gei1

rows.note: Use this for the internal mechanical arrangement of parts, especially in technical descriptions of transmission or control.

example.english: This gear mechanism can reduce the motor's rotational speed.
example.traditional: 此齒輪機構可將馬達轉速減慢。
example.jyutping: ci2 ci2 leon4 gei1 kau3 ho2 zoeng1 maa5 daat6 zyun3 cuk1 gaam2 maan6
